wholesale-plastic-water-bottle-buying-gu.title: Wholesale quotation: compare like-for-like offers
wholesale-plastic-water-bottle-buying-gu.intro: A low unit price is meaningful only when two suppliers are quoting the same product configuration, packing and delivery scope. Use this purchasing matrix before selecting a supplier.
head: Check
Lower-risk choice

Logistics
Carton count, dimensions, gross weight and Incoterm stated in writing
Is freight included, and who pays duties, export clearance and destination handling?
Document control
Reference sample, revision code and inspection criteria specified
Which documents will be supplied for this finished SKU and destination market?

PETG and seals

Document for actual body resin, gasket material and complete finished bottle
